Ivy (CS): LuminaHealth returned the vendor questionnaire but left the DPA unsigned and did not attach SOC2 evidence. They indicated "bring-your-own-key" but didn't name the KMS/HSM vendor.

Mark R: Quick scan 7: missing signed DPA, SOC2 AOC or report (last 12 months), named KMS/HSM vendor and a simple key lifecycle note. Also ask for a data flow diagram and retention TTLs for embeddings/logs.

Ivy (CS): Drafting request to customer. Any DPA preferences? @Legal

Legal: Default to Redwood DPA v3. If they propose changes to caps or SLA, capture redlines and a short business-impact note. Small wording tweaks can be handled, material liability cap changes require escalation.

Ivy (CS): Message sent to LuminaHealth:
> Hi LuminaHealth team, thanks for the questionnaire. Could you please attach the signed Redwood DPA (v3) and either a SOC2 AOC or SOC2 report covering the most recent 12 months? Also confirm the KMS/HSM vendor for BYOK (e.g., AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSM vendor) and provide a short key rotation note. Please share a simple data flow diagram showing PII handling and retention TTLs for embeddings and logs. We can provide an SFTP link for sensitive uploads.

Mark R: Please add this checklist to the intake record:
- Signed DPA (Redwood DPA v3)
- SOC2 AOC or report (last 12 months)
- Named KMS/HSM vendor + rotation cadence
- Data flow diagram (PII path)
- Retention policy excerpt (embeddings/logs)

SecOpsBot: Reminder: Vendor intake "LuminaHealth" has 4 outstanding evidence items. Assigned to Ivy (CS). Deadline: 2025-06-10.

LuminaHealth (reply): Uploaded SOC2 Type 2 (2024) and confirmed on-prem HSM (Thales) for BYOK. DPA unsigned  requesting a change to liability cap and a clause to permit limited audit windows.

Ivy (CS): Uploaded SOC2 to /shared/customer-evidence/LuminaHealth/soc2_2024_type2.pdf and noted HSM vendor. Routing DPA redlines to Legal.

Legal: Received redlines. Liability cap change is material; we'll prepare a short risk memo. Will respond within 48 hours.

SecOpsBot: Evidence upload detected: /shared/customer-evidence/LuminaHealth/soc2_2024_type2.pdf

AM-Jordan: Renewal review in 4 weeks. Mark renewal risk in Gainsight as "evidence pending - legal review" if DPA unsigned after Legal response window.

Ivy (CS): Thanks all. I'll update Gainsight and escalate if Legal doesn't approve redlines. Will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
